extracted.intended_audience: writers seeking literary agents/editors and submission guidance
extracted.subtask_description: A searchable directory of agents and editors listing the genres, formats, age groups, and submission notes they are actively seeking so authors can target submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search form instructions
rubrics_metrics.description: The form below allows you to search by a number of criteria. You may use both the checkboxes and the name search together to help drill down your search.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: Results display below the form and refresh each time you hit Search. We recommend searching for one genre at a time to receive a more targeted list. More questions? Check out our search guide.
